description: Implements ADR-005 decisions 2 and 3; supersedes ADR-003. Add SQLite on the /data volume as the control plane (the deliberate exception to ADR-001's no-DB rule — content stays in files). Schema: accounts (opaque anonymous userId, pseudonymous credential, no real name), source/device→account mapping (makes ADR-004 same-me-everywhere real), durable OAuth clients/codes/tokens (in-memory OAuth from ADR-003 dies on every redeploy of the always-on server), and Stripe customer/subscription state. oauth-provider.ts swaps its in-memory Maps for the SQLite-backed store (the OAuthServerProvider interface already supports this). Signup/login flow (pseudonymous). Acceptance: tokens survive a redeploy; one human with CLI+web+second-laptop resolves to one userId.
title: Durable accounts + persistent OAuth/billing store (SQLite control plane)
